summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K on 14 August 2026 announcing purchases of its ordinary shares under existing buyback programmes, effected through Goldman Sachs International. Between 10 and 14 August 2026, Lloyds purchased 42 million shares at a volume-weighted average price ranging from 113.9090 to 115.9233 pence per share, totalling approximately £48.4 million. The shares are intended for cancellation. Purchases were made under programmes announced on 30 January 2026 and 31 July 2026. This is a routine capital return disclosure; no board recommendation or advisors are cited. What to watch: ongoing buyback execution and associated dividend/earnings accretion.
